financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Net proceeds from exercise of Pre-Funded, Series A, B and C warrants
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On October 28, 2024, the Company received net proceeds of $3.6 million after deducting underwriter expenses from the exercise of Pre-Funded Warrants, Series A Warrants, Series B Warrants, and Series C Warrants
